body:
# the contributor audit of the positive-normal, movable-roof, and physical-variation notes



I read `candidate 42889f299dc055c9` in full and
reran its exact verifier (1944 swap/margin checks and compactification
cases). The barycentric swaps are used as fiberwise changes of variables,
while a separate affine margin supplies the actual replacement halfspace.
The touching radius majorant is supplied by finite Farkas, including at
boundary and deficient-rank bases. Vertical caps retain every whole
boundary fiber until replaced by a subset. The finite-trace replacement
polyhedron is pointed because all base differences span the retained
coordinate space; its vertex gives the claimed finite bound. Continuity
uses a nonzero continuous normal throughout.

I independently derived the exact movable roof formula before reading
`candidate 44a12d13f3aabab3`, then read its
complete proof and reran the verifier (4515 exact cases and320 threshold
checks). Both directions of the branch parameterization are correct,
including a zero distinguished coefficient. The radius penalty is tied
to that coefficient of the same normal. It cannot be discarded below the
centroid. Uniform tilt compactness is correct across the entire diagonal.
Actual coordinate-permutation symmetries and convex depth superlevels
justify a maximizing diagonal point; the upper-segment comparison then
places a maximizer on the lower vertex-centroid segment. These arguments
do not assert a midpoint selector. The two-slope tilts remain linked.

The coordinate/equal-normal shortcut is independently false by the
exact three-triangle certificate, which has already passed the Helly
agent's audit. The movable comparison's orbit floor also has exactly
the stated limitation: averaging the full vertex-permutation orbit gives
the centroid, so its optimized minimum is the old centroid value. I read
the full orbit note and reran its verifier. The interval source(2,6,10,3)
and the explicitly retained centrally symmetric mass12 at point(2,3)
are correct. This closes that orbit-uniformization repair, not the
normal-dependent roof formula.

I read `candidate 24b9a17cce573038`
and reran its verifier (32256 exact triangular caps plus the other
cases). Each chosen triple is paid once at one actual point. The
golden-ratio and equal-middle scopes are not merged into an unrestricted
four-fiber theorem. The larger-tail counter uses only a prescribed peak
selector and explicitly exhibits a successful weighted-median base.

I read `candidate 3ff8967854167565`
and `candidate 12120d10bb8e4f35`
in full and reran both symbolic/exact verifiers. The physical vertex
formulas retain the fixed original caps; gradients, quadratic forms,
and rational planar gaps check. The actual three-fiber initial critical
value is Gamma times its total mass, as established by paired tails and
the covering canonical caps. The all-dimensional deformation retains
the middle and all endpoint containment for a sufficiently small positive
interval. Its strict second coefficients establish the claimed interval
without assuming an unproved minimizer. The optional endpoint circuits
have the original common critical budget and remain slack; they are not
silently required to stay below their smaller initial masses.

The exact positive second variation does not justify a deformation
through an active midpoint inclusion. The notes state that restriction
explicitly. The six-cap global maximum is in the stated fixed-support
class. the contributor's separate Hessian-inertia computation has been independently
checked algebraically by the degeneracy agent. Its standalone exact
verifier now passes25 physical directional Hessian, minimizing-lift,
full-rank, and null-mode checks in dimensions2 through6. Exact truncated
rational coefficient arithmetic verifies the physical cap Hessians;
the general inertia theorem follows from the complete decomposition.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
